text:
[Council File 26-0008-S18; CD 2]
Resolution (Nazarian – Rodriguez) relative to prohiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during the hours of 2:00 am and 6:00 am along certain street segments in Council District Two pursuant to Los Angeles Muncipal Code Section 80.69.4.
​​​​​​​
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Resolution to bar parking of vehicles longer than 22 feet or taller than 84 inches from 2:00 to 6:00 a.m. on specified street segments in Council District 2.
